title: Jobs (cloud)

panels.title: Successful executions, by job
panels.description: A gap where a job's cadence says a run should be is a missed run.

panels.title: Failed executions, by job
panels.description: Executions that failed after their retries (`jobs-failed`; `audit-chain` for the audit jobs, urgent). For tpa-jobs a failed run is any tenant not `ok`.

panels.title: Schedules that could not start their job
panels.description: Cloud Scheduler attempts that finished in error, by schedule and status (`scheduler-failed`). PERMISSION_DENIED means an invoker binding is not what the gate thinks.

panels.title: Run summaries, by job
panels.description: One per tpa-jobs scheduled run (`tpa_jobs_runs`); the drains' ticks are on the Portal & API page.

panels.title: Alerts raised, by job
panels.description: Alert records the scheduled runs raised in the time range (`jobs-alerts`; the paging ones urgent; two `tenants_partial` in a day `jobs-partial-recurring`).

panels.title: Reconciliations left open per tenant
panels.description: The outstanding reconciliations accumulator_reconcile left open, one point per tenant per run. `accumulator-backlog-growing` opens when tonight's total is above last night's.
